title: Mr Alistair Richardson — General Osteopathic Council decision (2026-01-06)
text:
Case No: 1820/10730
GOsC Professional Conduct Committee

Page 1 of 1
6 January 2026
GENERAL OSTEOPATHIC COUNCIL
PROFESSIONAL CONDUCT COMMITTEE

Case No: 1820/10730

Interim Suspension Order Hearing

DECISION

Case of:
Alistair Richardson

Committee:
Andrew Harvey (Panel Chair)

Rachel Forster (Lay member)
Catherine Hamilton-Plant (Osteopathic
member)

Legal Assessor: Peter Steel

Representation for Council:
Paul Renteurs

Representation for Osteopath: Ian Skeate

Clerk to the Committee:
Richard Bunce

Date of Hearing:
6 January 2026

Summary of Decision:

In accordance with the GOsC Publication Policy, where an Interim Order is made,
a summary of the decision will be published on the GOsC’s website.

The Professional Conduct Committee (PCC) determined that it was necessary to
impose an interim suspension order over Mr Alistair Richardson’s registration. The
allegations in this case relate to breaches of sexual boundaries. This means that
Mr Richardson is no longer able to practise as an osteopath until the case is
concluded by the PCC.
